title: Google Play Developer Leads
description: Find app companies by keyword, category or competitor app; get one lead per developer with public business contacts.

searchTerms.title: Keywords
searchTerms.description: What the apps do, for example invoice maker, meditation or food delivery. Each keyword finds up to 30 apps on Google Play; with Similar apps on, each of them adds the apps Google shows as similar.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Also take the developers of the top charts of these categories (up to 200 apps per chart).

appIds.title: Competitor apps
appIds.description: Package names or Google Play links, for example com.zoho.invoice. Their developers are included, and with Similar apps on, the developers of the apps Google shows as similar: your competitors' competitors.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Developer names or Google Play developer links, to get their contact record.

includeSimilarApps.title: Similar apps
includeSimilarApps.description: For apps found by keyword and competitor apps, also take the apps Google shows as similar. Finds many more developers in the same niche; takes a little longer.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter Google Play countries to search, for example US, GB, DE. US when empty.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of app pages, for example en or de.

companiesOnly.title: Companies only
companiesOnly.description: Keep developers that are businesses: a company form in the name (Inc, Ltd, GmbH, AB...) or a support email on their own website's domain. Individual developers' emails, addresses and phones are never saved; turning this off adds them with name, website and apps only.

requireEmail.title: Only with email
requireEmail.description: Keep only developers with a public business email.

requireWebsite.title: Only with website
requireWebsite.description: Keep only developers with a website.

minInstalls.title: Minimum installs of the top app
minInstalls.description: For example 100000 for established developers. Leave empty for any.

maxInstalls.title: Maximum installs of the top app
maxInstalls.description: For example 1000000 to skip the giants and reach small and mid-size developers. Leave empty for no limit.

updatedWithinDays.title: Top app updated in the last days
updatedWithinDays.description: Keep active developers only, for example 90. Leave empty for any.

maxLeads.title: Maximum leads
maxLeads.description: Stop after this many leads. You pay only for leads saved. 0 means no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly, which is fastest. If Google Play starts limiting requests, it switches to Apify Proxy automatically. Turn on a proxy here only to use it from the start.
